voice.name: Open Sector - Supply Boat
voice.description: Weathered old male sailor in his sixties, salty gravelly voice roughened by decades of sea wind and pipe smoke, slow drawling West Country style seafaring accent, grumbling but kind, unhurried and wry, calling over a ship radio.
voice.sample: Aye, aye, I hear you. Forty years on these waters and still they've got me hauling crates. Mind the swell, lads, cargo's coming alongside. Fresh shells and tinned beans, the finest the navy can spare.

ready: Supply launch, loaded to the gunwales.

move.prompt: Old cargo launch diesel engine chugging steadily, low putt-putt rhythm, water lapping against wooden hull, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Small wooden boat breaking apart and sinking, cracking timbers, big splash, bubbling and gurgling water swallowing the hull, medium distance, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Cargo transfer between boats at sea, rope pulley squeaking, crates swung over and thudding onto a wooden deck, water lapping, close, no music, no voice
